headline: TikTok bans Musk documentary account
summary: TikTok has banned the social media account for Alex Gibney's upcoming Musk documentary. The film's distributor was informed of a "permanent suspension." TikTok has not yet commented on the ban.

headline: Mercedes-AMG's first ground-up SUV is a 1,150hp electric beast
summary: Mercedes-AMG unveiled its first dedicated electric SUV, the 2028 GT SUV, boasting over 1,150 horsepower. This ultra-fast-charging vehicle marks the brand's first ground-up electric SUV. It promises top-tier performance akin to its GT four-door coupe sibling.

headline: Elon Musk settles lawsuits over $1 million voter giveaway
summary: Elon Musk has settled two lawsuits concerning his 2024 promise of a $1 million daily voter giveaway. The promotion faced legal challenges and fraud claims from Arizona residents. The terms of the settlement were not immediately disclosed.

headline: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
summary: Meta has updated its terms of service, removing language that suggested it could scrape content for AI training. The change follows backlash over potential scraping of news sites and other online content. Meta aims to clarify its data usage policies for AI development.

headline: Battlefield 6 Devs Respond After Players Take Aim at 'Secuty' Typo and Cosmetic With 5 Pistols
summary: Battlefield 6 developers responded to player criticism regarding new Season 5 cosmetics. Players specifically targeted a 'Secuty' typo and a controversial five-pistol cosmetic. The team's statement aims to address community feedback.

headline: James Cameron Congratulates Marvel After Avengers: Endgame Beats Avatar at the Box Office Yet Again
summary: James Cameron congratulated Marvel after 'Avengers: Endgame' once again surpassed 'Avatar' at the box office. This marks another instance of the two films trading places for top grossing. Cameron acknowledged the achievement with a social media post.

headline: Ben Affleck's Batman Movie Would Have Featured Arkham Asylum-Inspired Deathstroke Fight and DCEU Batgirl, Joe Manganiello Reveals
summary: Joe Manganiello revealed new details about Ben Affleck's canceled Batman film. The movie would have included an Arkham Asylum-inspired fight with Deathstroke. It also planned to feature the DCEU's Batgirl.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Cyberpunk 2077 for Switch 2, Pikmin 4, Star Wars Zero Company, and More
summary: Discover today's top gaming deals, including Cyberpunk 2077 for the upcoming Switch 2. Score discounts on titles like Pikmin 4 and Star Wars Zero Company. Don't miss these limited-time offers on popular games.

headline: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as over 1,000 arrested after protests
summary: Widespread disorder erupted across France with over 1,000 arrests following cost of living protests. Cities saw violent clashes, extensive looting, and buildings set ablaze. Over half a million people reportedly joined the nationwide demonstrations.

headline: How day of protests unfolded as disorder breaks out across France
summary: Demonstrations across France escalated into widespread disorder throughout the day. Cars and buildings were set alight amidst the protests. Shops were also ransacked in various locations.

headline: More NHS staff sacked over attacks victims' records
summary: Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust has dismissed more staff for mismanaging attack victims' records. A new system will be implemented to better protect sensitive patient information. The trust aims to enhance data security protocols following the incidents.

headline: Anti-government protesters battle with police in Albania
summary: Violent clashes erupted between anti-government demonstrators and riot police in Albania's capital, Tirana. Protesters and police battled throughout Saturday during the demonstrations. The unrest reflects ongoing tensions against the government.
